title: Check a SPEI payment
Comprueba un pago SPEI
查证一笔 SPEI 付款
Kiểm tra một khoản SPEI
summary: Retrieve the CEP for an authorized existing payment and inspect its signature and transaction binding.
Obtén el CEP de un pago existente autorizado y revisa su firma y vinculación con la operación.
为已获授权的现有付款取得 CEP，查看签名与精确交易绑定。
Lấy CEP của khoản thanh toán đã được phép và kiểm tra chữ ký cùng liên kết giao dịch.
inputs: Operation date, tracking key, sending and receiving institution codes, account, amount and authorization reference.
output: Task status, original-evidence availability, signature status and exact transaction binding. Pending or unavailable remains inconclusive.
boundary: Does not initiate a transfer or prove present account control, identity or a safe payout. Source access restrictions can delay a task.
topics: A payment screenshot versus a signed CEP: what can your reconciliation job accept?
Recover a pending SPEI evidence request without creating a duplicate
audience: Mexico payment operations, reconciliation developers and finance automation teams
